853:t_53:11.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Cut it out, AG. Stop it.」

853:t_53:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're strong, cute, and just the absolute best! Please let me call you Big Sis too!」

853:t_53:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... You went cold on me in an instant...」

853:t_54:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of the $$トップレス$$ Representative...! You must be used to celebrations like this.」

853:t_54:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But those are more like ceremonies. Having someone tell me their congratulations in person like this isn't bad.」

853:t_54:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You have a surprisingly cute side, Miss $$ラルク$$.」

853:t_54:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even your blushing is cute! Cute, cute, cute, Miss $$ラルク$$!」

853:t_54:11.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Cut it out, AG. Stop it.」

853:t_54:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're strong, cute, and just the absolute best! Please let me call you Big Sis too!」

853:t_54:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... You went cold on me in an instant...」

853:t_55:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so cold, Miss $$チコ$$. Being like that at such a young age is no fun at all.」

853:t_55:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For someone as cold as you, here is the perfect present. Here you go, an ice pop.」

853:t_55:8.en:
$$チコ$$
「...Did you maybe know what I like?」

853:t_55:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, of course. Information is the lifeblood of a dimensional merchant.」

853:t_55:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a masterpiece, frozen at minus 1 trillion 20 million degrees. Please, enjoy it.」

853:t_55:11.en:
$$チコ$$
「Thank you, AG. I'll dig in.」

853:t_55:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If I can see a smile on Miss $$チコ$$'s face, then all my preparations were worth it.」

853:t_56:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you, AG. So, what's the bonus prize?」

853:t_56:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Shall I treat you to some sushi?」

853:t_56:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Are you going to order tea there and try to rattle me with some talk of 'agari'?」

853:t_56:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Too bad! My plan was to spot the pickled ginger and say, 'Ah, gari.'」

853:t_56:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Ugh... I didn't see that one coming...」

853:t_57:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ガムリン$$!」

853:t_57:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That refreshing smile... I might fall for you.」

853:t_57:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh... Why is it that Miss $$ミレーヌ$$ doesn't notice Mr. $$ガムリン$$'s charm...?」

853:t_57:8.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I-I don't think that's true! $$ミレーヌ$$ really does look at me properly!」

853:t_57:9.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「N-no... that's wrong! Acting while conscious of $$ミレーヌ$$'s eyes like that is impure!」

853:t_57:10.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I'll improve myself even more, and have $$ミレーヌ$$ see it... No good! Then in the end, I'm just thinking of $$ミレーヌ$$'s eyes...」

853:t_57:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「(A capable soldier with the heart of a pure boy... That must be Mr. $$ガムリン$$'s charm...)」

853:t_58:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, counting by the number of kills doesn't please you...」

853:t_58:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let me put it another way! The number of fans whose hearts were blasted away by Mr. $$バサラ$$'s songs has passed 80!」

853:t_58:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Hell yeah! A thousand, ten thousand... no, I'll keep singing until I've blasted the heart of every last one of you!!」

853:t_58:8.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「He's as simple as ever...」

853:t_58:9.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「That's the kind of guy $$バサラ$$ is.」

853:t_58:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a fan myself, I'll be looking forward to what miracles Mr. $$バサラ$$'s songs bring about.」

853:t_59:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「This is just a waypoint. I'm going to get even stronger.」

853:t_59:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Riding your feelings on your wings, is it...」

853:t_59:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those feelings... don't you ever think they're heavy?」

853:t_59:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no, not at all. At times a person's feelings become a heavy, heavy shackle that binds them.」

853:t_59:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll fly anyway. I have wings that can carry even that.」

853:t_59:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「(That decisiveness, that freedom, that manly charm he shows from time to time... No wonder girls fall head over heels...)」

853:t_60:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I've got the pride of $$スカル$$ 1 to uphold. Handing the ace's seat over to the rookies is a long way off.」

853:t_60:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Which means that someday you intend to hand over the Major's seat to someone too...?」

853:t_60:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That was just a figure of speech. I don't intend to lose to anyone.」

853:t_60:7.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Not even to protect the woman I love.」

853:t_60:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since we're at it, let's say that line... in front of Miss $$キャシー$$.」

853:t_61:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ミシェル$$!」

853:t_61:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I've stuck to quietly providing support, but with my skills, this is about what you'd expect.」

853:t_61:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of a sniper! You always bring down both your target and the girl, right!?」

853:t_61:6.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Talk is cheap. Lately, though, I keep swinging and missing with the girl.」

853:t_61:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then isn't it about time you blasted through the target you've been carefully aiming at?」

853:t_61:8.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You don't have to tell me. Being not-quite-lovers childhood friends forever is frustrating.」

853:t_62:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Thank you, AG. But this isn't only my own strength.」

853:t_62:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. It's also the strength of Mr. $$ルカ$$'s faithful servants $$シモン$$, John, and Peter, isn't it?」

853:t_62:6.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That's not all. $$ナナセ$$ gives me strength.」

853:t_62:8.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That's it! I'll tell $$ナナセ$$ about this and have her celebrate with me!」

853:t_62:9.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That would be the best present for me!」

853:t_62:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...So my words of congratulations aren't worth a fart to you...」

853:t_63:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「Mm... Now I can hold my head high before $$ネネ$$ and $$ララミア$$.」

ネネ.evidence: Klan's Meltrandi comrade (Macross DYRL: Nene Romanova); not in glossary sheet

ララミア.evidence: Klan's Meltrandi comrade (Macross DYRL: Lamia Loveless); not in glossary sheet
